Flagelo para a saúde, o açúcar é também indissociável do capitalismo e dos crimes ligados à colonização e à escravatura. 'Quando trabalhamos nos engenhos de açúcar e a mó nos apanha o dedo, cortam-nos a mão; quando tentamos fugir, cortam-nos a perna: vivi ambas as situações. É a esse preço que comem açúcar na Europa', relatava já Voltaire em Cândido, em 1759.

programme.title: Wonders Of The Ocean T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Song Of The Rainforest T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Established in 2021, Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park is one of the first five national parks ever created in China. This biodiversity hotspot, which covers humid lowland tropical rainforests up through the cloud forests that blanket 1800-meter peaks, features rare species like the Hainan black-crested gibbon, orchids found only here and the misty moss-covered terrain of its highest elevations. programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour. programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the worlds most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravels Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Edouards death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouards nurse and her husband. programme.title: Truk lagoon: le Grand Cimetière Sour la Mer
programme.desc: Ce documentaire nous mène de lautre côté de lHistoire, en Micronésie, à Truk ; archipel oublié au milieu de locéan Pacifique. Dans cet archipel, le sort dun empire et celui de la moitié du monde a été scellé sous la mer les 17 et 18 février de 1944, lors de lOpération de U.S. Navy, baptisée Hailstone. Les Américains ont fait sauter le verrou qui commandait lissue de la guerre du Pacifique. Chaque été, les feux gagnent en violence et laissent derrière eux bien plus que des paysages calcinés : des familles déplacées, des pompiers à bout, des villages traumatisés. Ces témoignages racontent ce moment où tout bascule, quand il faut fuir, sauver ce quon peut et apprendre ensuite à survivre à laprès.
